programme.title: The Zoo: A Sea Lion Pup Grows Up
programme.desc: Zoo staff face unexpected setbacks weaning a bright sea lion pup off its mother's milk the bird team steps in to support a rejected curassow chick a squirrel monkey visits the dentist.

programme.title: My Cat From Hell: Fluffy's Last Stand
programme.desc: A mother and daughter are being torn apart by their cat Missy, who seems determined to kill their other cat Fluffy a tortie named Candy beats up a 9-year-old because she isn't so sweet.

programme.title: Mystery of the Lost Islands: Shark Island
programme.desc: Biologist and predator specialist Dave Salmoni journeys to an island in the South Pacific, which is home to a large concentration of sharks.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Steve's Legacy Continues
programme.desc: After months of croc-wrangling training with Steve Irwin's best friend Wes, Robert, Steve's son, takes the final step in his journey to feed Graham, a huge crocodile at the zoo's famous Crocoseum.

programme.title: Meet the Orangutans: Climbing And Nest-Building
programme.desc: Peanut is reluctant to climb twins Ceria and Sen need training to stop their misbehavior Boogie Boy must learn to build a nest.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R.
programme.desc: From rhino saviors and lion researchers to savvy entrepreneurs and armed security teams, Ivan tours the front lines of conservation to meet the individuals who are reshaping and protecting wild Africa. Ivan journeys to four separate countries.

programme.title: Bear vs. Shark
programme.desc: Putting his wits and survival skills to the test, adventurer Bear Grylls faces off with the ocean's apex predator he goes chumming from a helicopter, diving into a feeding frenzy and posing as human bait.

programme.title: The Zoo: The Marvelous Mott Mott
programme.desc: Beloved camel Max develops a large abscess on the top of his head a marmot prepares for her first classroom visit as an ambassador animal a peregrine falcon found at the base of a skyscraper is brought to the zoo for a health check.

programme.title: My Cat From Hell: My Pup From Hell
programme.desc: Jackson works with Sydney, a Bengal, who's welcoming his new stepmom and new pit bull brother into the family by spraying every piece of furniture in the house an energetic cat, Stella, threatens to harm a toddler.
